info.name: RentIt - Rental Lifecycle Module
info.description:
Standalone Postman suite for the RentIt rental lifecycle & approvals module.

Run order: "0. Setup" first (seeds demo users + equipment and captures their ids into environment variables), then any other folder top-to-bottom. Each folder after Setup creates its own fresh booking as its first request, so folders can be re-run independently as long as Setup has run at least once.

Auth: this collection uses the x-user-id / x-user-role dev headers (only active when ENABLE_DEV_ROUTES=true, the .env.example default). Swap these for a real `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header once wired into the full RentIt backend - see auth.js.
